actualActions: The wave-30 P2 is closed: revalidation now always checks time (real clock when now is omitted), so identical content with a future observedAt is refused; invalid now/maxFactsAgeMs -> invalid_clock.
Current configuration is re-parsed with the public schema: unsupported version, malformed body or a removed project is stale configuration instead of trusting a bare revision.
An expired project scope is needs_input project_scope_expired at generation and stale expiry at reuse.

fourOutcomes.title: bounded reads and version governance for real projects
fourOutcomes.goal: Reliable Node module around repeated reads, file replacement and missing capabilities; no new scanner or install system.
actualActions: MetadataLimits themselves are validated: zero, negative, fractional, NaN, Infinity and oversized budgets are invalid_limits, so a caller cannot lift a read bound.
Observations carry bounded field-level omissions (too_large / truncated / unsupported / not_observed) so an empty list never looks like a complete source.
lstat/open inode+size and post-read size/mtime checks, NOFOLLOW, regular-file, whitelist and root checks are retained; repeated bounded reads of the same tree stay deterministic and read-only.
Unknown stack/manager/version remain needs_input/unsupported; monorepo members are never guessed; only registered checks/profiles are referenced.
fourOutcomes.consumer: main's ProductProjectRecipes via createProjectFactsObserver (registered root only, no arbitrary path).
